properties.description: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland.
properties.longDescription: Attractive three bedroom semi-detached family home situated within 0.5 miles of Petts Wood station with fast trains to London and within easy walking distance of local shops, schools, bus routes and National Trust woodland. The property comprises; two receptions, fitted 18'9 x 10'1 kitchen/breakfast room and conservatory. The property also benefits from having a utility room and cloakroom. To the first floor there are three bedrooms and a family bathroom with separate WC. Additional features include double glazing, gas central heating and a well presented interior.
properties.location: Petts Wood Road, Petts Wood, Orpington BR5

properties.description: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat.
properties.longDescription: Presented in excellent decorative order throughout is this two double bedroom, two bathroom, garden flat. The modern fitted kitchen is open plan to the living room which boasts solid wooden floors and includes integrated appliances including a dishwasher & a washing machine. This large open plan benefits from bi folding doors onto a secluded private courtyard garden. Both bedrooms are double sized, and the family bathroom boasts a matching three piece suite a shower attachment over the bath. There is also a separate wet room. There are walnut doors throughout and wiring for Sky TV/aerial points in the living room/kitchen and both bedrooms. This apartment being only five years old, is still under a 10 year building guarantee.

properties.description: Spacious 4-bedroom family house in Westminster with modern amenities and excellent transport links.
properties.longDescription: Impressive family home featuring four double bedrooms, spacious reception rooms, and a contemporary fitted kitchen. The property includes a master bedroom with en-suite, family bathroom, downstairs cloakroom, and a private rear garden. Excellent transport links and close to top-rated schools. Perfect for growing families seeking space and convenience.

properties.description: Cozy 1-bedroom flat in Whitechapel, perfect for first-time buyers or investors.
properties.longDescription: Perfect starter home or investment property. This compact yet well-designed flat offers an open-plan living area with modern kitchen, a comfortable bedroom with built-in wardrobes, and a contemporary bathroom. Located in a secure building with entry phone system, close to Whitechapel station and the bustling Brick Lane area. Ideal for young professionals.

properties.description: Luxurious 5-bedroom house in Mayfair with period features and modern kitchen.
properties.longDescription: Exceptional period property in one of London's most prestigious addresses. This magnificent home boasts five generous bedrooms, three bathrooms, elegant reception rooms with original features, and a state-of-the-art kitchen. Additional features include a private patio garden, wine cellar, and parking. Located moments from Hyde Park and world-class shopping and dining.

properties.description: Contemporary 2-bedroom flat in Southwark with 24-hour concierge and gym.
properties.longDescription: Stylish apartment in a modern development with excellent amenities. Features include a bright open-plan living space, contemporary kitchen with integrated appliances, two double bedrooms with ample storage, and a sleek family bathroom. The development offers a 24-hour concierge, residents' gym, and is within walking distance of London Bridge and Borough Market.

properties.description: Charming 3-bedroom Victorian house in Islington with period features and garden.
properties.longDescription: Delightful Victorian terraced house offering period charm with modern updates. Features include three well-proportioned bedrooms, a bright through-lounge, contemporary kitchen/breakfast room, and a family bathroom. The property retains many original features including fireplaces and high ceilings. Benefits from a lovely rear garden and is located on a quiet residential street close to excellent schools, shops, and transport.
